sql:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT year(service_date) AS yr, SUM(trips) AS trips
  FROM trips_daily
  WHERE year(service_date) IN (2024, 2025)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2024 THEN trips END) AS trips_2024,
  MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2025 THEN trips END) AS trips_2025,
  ROUND(100.0 * (MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2025 THEN trips END) - MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2024 THEN trips END))
        / MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 2024 THEN trips END), 1) AS pct_change
FROM t
notes: Assumes trips_daily covers all provider types and boroughs, so the full-year totals for 2024 and 2025 are compared directly as a percent change.

sql:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT SUM(complaints) AS complaints
  FROM complaints_daily
  WHERE year(opened_date) = 2024
),
t AS (
  SELECT SUM(trips) AS trips
  FROM trips_daily
  WHERE year(service_date) = 2024
)
SELECT ROUND(1000.0 * c.complaints / t.trips, 2) AS complaint_rate_per_1000
FROM c, t
notes: Assumes the full calendar year 2024 for both complaints (by opened_date) and completed trips (by service_date), with no provider type or category filter, so the rate covers all complaints and all trips.
